title.narrative: Financial Inclusion and technical assistance guarantee

description.narrative: Projektet riktar sig mot den höga informaliteten i den ekonomiska sektorn i Bolivia, den låga nivån av finansiell integration och de svårigheter som mikroföretag och små företag står inför för att få tillgång till finansiering för sin verksamhet. Insatsen syftar parallellt till att bidra till hållbar affärsverksamhet och miljömedvetenhet bland entreprenörer. Projektet ämnar också ha en positiv inverkan på de allvarliga ekonomiska konsekvenserna och svårigheterna för utsatta grupper och entreprenörer i efterdyningarna av COVID 19. Ekonomisk inkludering är ett medel för att uppnå större jämställdhet när det gäller möjligheter och resurser, skapa ekonomiska möjligheter för utsatta grupper och bidra till en hållbar ekonomisk utveckling i Bolivia. Genomförandepartnern föreslås vara PROFIN, en ideell boliviansk organisation, specialiserad på produktiv och ekonomisk utveckling. Programmet är kopplat till planen för att inrätta en garantifond i Bolivia med FOGAL som avtalspartner. För att stödja upprättandet och genomförandet av garantin kommer programmet PROFIN att ge tekniskt stöd. Detta stöd kommer att bestå av olika komponenter inom ramen för det föreslagna projektet såsom; - Finansiell utbildning. PROFIN har lång erfarenhet och kunskap om den finansiella sektorn och målgrupperna för garantin och kommer att arbeta parallellt med att tillhandahålla finansiell utbildning både till familjeproduktionsenheter (UPF) och till finansinstitut angående risker och målgrupper. Detta förväntas leda till ökad tillgång till finansiella tjänster och ökad räckvidd och inkludering av nya målgrupper för de finansiella instituten. -Identifiera och utveckla en finansiell mekanism/uppföljningssystem för att bidra till genomförandet av Agenda 2030 -Studie av det rättsliga systemet i Bolivia för inrättande av FOGAL-landskontor, förespråkande och studier för att ge råd och påverka lagar och normer som begränsar de nuvarande finansiella systemen. -PROFIN kommer att ge stöd till FOGAL i etablerandet av partnerskapskontrakt med lokala finansinstitut. -Övervakning och uppföljning av lån PROFIN kommer att implementera ett uppföljningssystem som rör målen för hållbar utveckling och kommer också att utforska nya finansieringsverktyg och metoder. Projektet kommer att löpa över fem år med en total budget på 9 012 598SEK. Sidas bidrag föreslås i första hand finansiera de första tre åren av projektet med en budget på 5 991 917 SEK. Projektet kommer att börja med en startfas för att anpassa och justera förslaget till en baslinje och till den ekonomiska och politiska situationen.

The contribution is targeting the high informality of the economic sector in Bolivia, the low level of financial inclusion and the difficulties micro and small enterprises faces to access finance for their business. The intervention is in parallel aiming to contribute to sustainable businesses and environmental consciousness among entrepreneurs. The intervention is also responding to the severe economic consequences and difficulties vulnerable groups and entrepreneurs phases in the aftermaths of COVID 19. The Embassy assess that financial inclusion is a mean to achieve a greater equality in terms of opportunities and resources, creating financial opportunities for vulnerable groups and contribute to a sustainable economic development in Bolivia. The implementing partner is proposed to be PROFIN, a non profit Bolivian organisation specialized in productive and financial development. The project is connected to the plan of setting up a guarantee fund in Bolivia with FOGAL as the contractual partner. To support the set up and the implementation of the guarantee PROFIN will be providing Technical Assistance through this proposed project. This assistance will consist of different components such as; - Financial education. PROFIN has long experience and knowledge of the financial sector and the target groups of the guarantee and will work in parallel to provide financial education both to Family Production Units (UPFs) and to financial institutions regarding risks and target groups. This is expected to result in a greater access and a greater use of financing from financial entities, -Identify and develop financial mechanism/reporting system to contribute to the fulfillment of Agenda 2030 -study of the legal system in Bolivia for the set up of FOGAL country office, advocacy and studies to provide advice and influence the laws and norms limiting the current financial systems. -PROFIN will accompany FOGAL in seeking partnerships-contracts with local financial institutions. -Monitoring and follow up of loans PROFIN will implement a monitoring system relating to the Sustainable development goals and will also be exploring new financing tools and methods. The project is proposed to run over five years with a budget of approximately 10 MSEK. Sida is proposed to initially fund the first three years with a total budget of 5 991 917 SEK. The project will start with an inception phase in order to adjust and adapt the proposal to a baseline and to the changes economic and political situation.

The main objective with the contribution is to integrate financial innovation actions with landscape conservation actions to: i) promote the financial inclusion of small farmers/small producers of rural and indigenous community organizations (with emphasis on women and youth), to improve their individual economic conditions, ii) promote entrepreneurship, income generation and strengthen resilience, iii) implement financial education actions, iv) design appropriate and innovative financial products and services that include management advice for their small businesses and ventures

sector.narrative: Education/training in banking and financial services

description.narrative:
During this period, the intervention has been working in the development and implementation of a tiered financial education program (basic, intermediate, and advanced) with a gender-sensitive and culturally relevant approach (Edufina).
It has designed the Seguro de Oro Life and Health Insurance. In collaboration with the insurance company CREDISEGURO and the health services provider IGS, this insurance product has been developed as an innovative financial instrument to protect families in indigenous and rural communities within the intervention area. It is conceived as a response to the high vulnerability of producer and harvester families facing adverse health situations, accidents, or death. The insurance provides life coverage with health benefits for the insured person and their family. Its design includes elements of awareness and financial education to promote understanding, responsible use, and ownership by the insured individuals.
Also, PROFIN has been developing a financial product called the Future Sales Credit in partnership with the Development Financial Institution FONDECO IFD (using the PROFIN Innovation Fund) for an açaí harvesters association. This product is designed to facilitate access to financing for actors involved in sustainable value chains. Its first concrete application was with the Porvenir Açaí Harvesters Association, which supplies fruit to a regional processing plant (in Santa Cruz). Through this modality, the açaí sales contract serves as a real and sufficient guarantee to back the credit, allowing harvesters to access working capital in advance for their activities without needing traditional guarantees that often exclude small producers.
Additionally and regarding the strengthening of capacity, 295 people have been able to enter to the financial system through banking processes and use of digital banking (198 women and 97 men with effective access to financial services, including opening savings accounts and activating electronic banking), and 2,108 people (1,398 women and 710 men) through financial education processes.
Finally, more than 100,000 people have been sensitized through communication campaigns on the importance of financial education and the economic empowerment of women.
